attchmntText: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press release pertaining to HGS Q2 FY 2026-27 results attached.".
voiceSummary: Hinduja Global Solutions Limited Board approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory Auditors Haribhakti & Co. LLP issued Unmodified Review Reports. The reports highlight a potential tax demand of Rs. 281.59 Crore related to GAAR proceedings. The Bombay High Court granted an interim stay on the directive. No adjustment was made in the Statement pending final outcome. The auditor did not review the unaudited financial results of one foreign branch in the Philippines. This branch reported total assets of Rs. 213.43 crore as at September 30, 2026. Total revenue for the branch was Rs. 98.95 crore for the quarter and Rs. 191.88 crore for the half-year. Net profit after tax was Rs. 6.11 crore for the quarter and Rs. 21.42 crore for the half-year. The Board Meeting commenced at 2.15 p.m. IST and concluded at 6.10 p.m. IST on November 12, 2026.
